about_the_game:
In Altered Bloodlines, you will play as a 37 year old FBI Agent based in Boston. You just rescued six kidnapped young women, with the help of your partner, Sarah, and a pair of BPD Detectives, Luke and Hannah, but the case is far from over.

You will be drawn deep down the rabbit hole as you uncover vast conspiracies and a shadowy criminal enterprise previously believed to be nothing more than myth and legend and will have to rely on your friends, both old and new, to uncover the truth and protect those closest to you. Will your fledgling relationship with the lovely Luci survive all that you will experience and learn? Will you be able to protect all those close to you from harm? Only you can determine your ultimate fate as you search for the truth behind Altered Bloodlines.

Experience a gripping story full of mystery, romance, and passion as you strive to close the largest and most labyrinthine case of your career. 

FEATURES

  • A gripping story in the visual novel format.

  • Make choices to determine the path of the story and your relationships with several beautiful love interests.

  • As you progress through the story, unlock sexy images of many of the gorgeous women of Altered Bloodlines and view them in the gallery.

  • Experience steamy scenes with the captivating ladies of the game, unlocking them in the replay gallery.

  • Earn Steam achievements as you make your way through the story.

  • Additional chapters will be made available to purchase as affordable DLC as they are ready, expanding the story until it reaches its conclusion.

MEET THE CHARACTERS

  • THE MC, JAMES ACKERMAN

    • James is the main character of our story. He’s a 37 year old FBI agent working out of the Boston office with his partner Sarah.

      The story begins with James waking up in the hospital after suffering an injury while rescuing several kidnapped young women, what turns out to only be the beginning of an epic case involving a vast criminal empire.

      You will take on the role of James and can rename him if you so choose. You will develop your relationship with the captivating young Luci as you begin the case, but will your budding romance survive everything you learn?

  • LUCI COOPER

    • Luci is an 18 year old Freshman at the Massachusetts College of Art and Design. She was the sixth kidnapping victim and you felt an undeniable connection to her the instant you saw her photo in the case file.

  • SARAH LOCKWOOD

    • Sarah is a 35 year old FBI agent and has been your partner for eight years. The two of you are extremely close and have had a friends with benefits situation going on for most of your time as partners.

  • HAYLEIGH GRAHAM

    • Hayleigh is one of Luci’s closest friends and a freshman and Boston University.

  • HANNAH POWERS

    • Hannah is a 33 year old former Army Ranger and current detective with the Boston Police Department. Since partnering with your close friend Luke Robinson, she has also become a good friend of yours.

  • LUKE ROBINSON

    • Luke is a 37 year old detective with the Boston Police Department. You met on a case shortly after you were assigned to the Boston office and have been close friends ever since.

content_descriptors.notes:
Altered Bloodlines contains mature language, nudity, and graphic depictions of oral, vaginal, and other sexual activity.

All sexual situations are depicted as occurring between consenting adults.

The antagonists of Altered Bloodlines are a vast criminal organization that is involved in kidnapping and will resort to assassinating their own members to protect their secrets. This leads to many depictions of violence throughout the game, including the suicide of a corrupt FBI agent in future DLC.

This game includes adult themes, and is intended for adults 18 years and older. The characters, story, and events are works of fiction.

short_description: A troubling missing persons case soon snowballs into an investigation of a shadowy criminal enterprise and vast conspiracies that even affect your own family. Will you be able to solve the mystery while protecting those dear to you? Will your fledgling romance survive full knowledge of your past?
